crossRefs.note: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
“Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

translations.web: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
translations.bsb: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.
translations.kjv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
translations.asv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou fastenest up mine iniquity.
